verdict.rationale: Serving clean markdown at page URLs is a fair question for a documentation framework, so the axis applies. The docs describe only building MDX into static HTML, and a probe of docusaurus.io/docs.md returned HTTP 404. There is no evidence of a built-in .md endpoint per page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every published page serves clean markdown at its URL (e.g. appending .md) so agents skip the HTML
